Auflösen nimmt nur die Reihe weg, keinen: Dissolving only removes the franchise, not any film. Lumen won’t create it again — you can bring it back under “Cleanup”.
Bei Filmen und Serien nur eine Angabe da: For films and TV programmes this just says what’s stored here. Lumen recognises episodes by their name (S01E02) or by the season folder above them — even if this says “Films”.
Der Vermittler reicht nur verschlüsselte: The relay only passes encrypted bytes through. It never learns what anyone watches — even if you run it yourself. The apps need the fingerprint once to recognise this server.
Die Verwaltung kann hier Filme und Serie: Admins can put together films and programmes here, e.g. “Christmas Films”.
Ein Film, auf mehrere Dateien verteilt (: One film split across several files (a/b/c, CD1/CD2). In the browser the parts play one after another; once merged, the film plays straight through everywhere. Merging joins the parts without re-encoding; the parts are moved to the “.lumen-teile” folder.
Eine Farbe, eine Figur oder ein eigenes: A colour, a character or your own picture — Lumen scales it down to 256 pixels.
Fehlt dir ein Film oder eine Serie? Wüns: Missing a film or programme? Request it above.
Filme in Teilen, fehlende Dateien, nicht: Films in parts, missing files, unrecognised titles
Gelöscht wird nur die Sammlung — kein Fi: Only the collection is deleted — no film, no file.
Hier war die Zuordnung zu unsicher. Lieb: The match was too uncertain here. Better nothing than the wrong film. Search under “Match a Different Title” on the title page — or paste a TMDb or IMDb link.
Ist ein anderer Film — als eigenen Titel: It’s a different film — keep it as a separate title
Leg eine an — etwa „Weihnachtsfilme“ ode: Create one — e.g. “Christmas Films” or “Marvel in Order” — and use “Add to Collection” on a film’s page.
Lege eine Bibliothek an und zeige Lumen,: Create a library and show Lumen where your films are.
Lumen holt aus deinem bisherigen Server,: Lumen imports from your previous server what you’ve watched, where you left off, your favourites and ratings — {nur}.
Neue Folgen deiner Serien, neue Filme de: New episodes of your programmes, new films in your franchises, recently added — just for you.
Nichts Neues — Lumen meldet sich, sobald: Nothing new — Lumen will let you know as soon as a programme you’re watching gets new episodes.
Noch keine Reihen. Lumen erkennt sie von: No franchises yet. Lumen detects them automatically as soon as two films of a franchise are here — from the title (“Part 2”, “II”, “The Lord of the Rings: …”) or, with a TMDb key, reliably via TMDb.
Noch leer. Auf der Seite eines Films ode: Still empty. On a film or programme page: “Add to Collection”.
Sobald der Besitzer Filme hinzufügt, ers: As soon as the owner adds films, they’ll appear here.
TMDb kennt diesen Titel nicht. Was du hi: TMDb doesn’t know this title. What you enter here stays as it is — the title will no longer be listed under “not recognised”.
Titel, Schauspieler, Genre oder Jahr — a: Title, actor, genre or year — also “comedy 2019”, “films with Tom Hanks” or “thriller 80s”.
Vorspann für die ganze Serie gemerkt: Intro marked for the whole programme
Was du fertig geschaut hast, zuletzt Bee: What you’ve finished, most recent first — programmes once all episodes are watched. Only you can see this.
von Lumen am Titel erkannt: recognised by Lumen from the title
Änderst du etwas am Quelltext, trag dein: If you change the source code, enter your own location via LUMEN_SOURCE_URL — the licence requires it.
Wo deine Filme und Serien liegen: Where your films and programmes are stored
